## Completed

Batch 47’s A/B pages and eight A-page items are authored. Four local prerequisite proofs cover Kato transport, C² Chern integrality, C¹ Stokes, and solid-angle filling independence. The rank-one theorem includes the planned clutching and winding calculation.

The plan-spec page identities, category, library, order, and requirements match the design. The C² title clarification and helper-item additions are recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-47.notes.md).

Full-text sources were inspected and fetch-verified: [Tong’s lecture notes](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqm.pdf), [Avron–Seiler–Yaffe](https://phsites.technion.ac.il/avron/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2013/05/commun_math_phys_110_33-49_1987.pdf), and [Lee’s smooth manifolds text](https://julianchaidez.net/materials/reu/lee_smooth_manifolds.pdf). The Lee source supports the smooth Stokes input; the C¹ extension is proved locally.
